description: Who bought a Robinhood Chain token in the first 60 seconds after trading opened: how many wallets, what share of supply they took and still hold, how many bought in the very block trading opened, and which early buyers are linked to each other or to the dev by moving the token between them. Use for 'is this bundled?', 'was the launch sniped?'. Robinhood Chain only for now.
